newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Quinenco to issue ADRs in June.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Quinenco to issue ADRs in June.

text.p: Chilean firm Quinenco SA, the holding company for the Luksic industrial group, plans to start trading in the U.S. in June through an issue of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), said general manager Fernando Silva.
The company expects to raise around $395 million through the sale of 194 million shares in the local and international markets, he told reporters at a shareholders meeting.
"We believe the placement will be in the last week of June," said Silva.
The firm has yet to decide what percentage of the issue will sold to local and international investors, he said.

Funds from the sale will be used to finance new investments and restructure the debts of Quinenco's subsidiaries which include copper fabricator Madeco SA, brewery Compania Cervecerias Unidas and telecom VTR.
"The objective is to consolidate the businesses of Quinenco's subsidiaries," said Silva.
